description: This file defines a database migration script for upgrading or modifying the database schema and data in the OrangeHRM project to version 5.0 beta. It includes methods for renaming columns, adding new columns, creating tables, inserting permissions, updating menu items, screens, email templates, report display fields, filter fields, and other configuration related to the HRM system's database setup during the migration process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class that manages the database schema and data changes necessary to upgrade the OrangeHRM system to version 5.0 beta. It extends AbstractMigration and implements the 'up' method for schema updates, along with helper methods for various specific schema and data modifications.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the main database migration steps, including renaming columns, creating tables, inserting permissions, and updating existing data to conform to the 5.0 beta version schema.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '5.0-beta' indicating the migration version.

methods.name: updateHomePage
methods.description: Updates the home page URL/action for a specified user role.

methods.name: getEmailIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the email ID from the database by email name, with caching.

methods.name: updateEmailProcessorClassByEmailName
methods.description: Updates the class responsible for processing a specific email notification.

methods.name: updateEmailTemplateSubjectAndBodyByEmailNameAndRecipientRole
methods.description: Updates the subject and body templates of email notifications for a specific email name and recipient role.

methods.name: getReportDisplayGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a report display group by name, with caching.

methods.name: updateReportDisplayFieldByGroup
methods.description: Updates the class name for report display fields in a specific group.

methods.name: updateReportFilterFieldByFieldName
methods.description: Updates the class name for report filter fields by field name.

methods.name: renameReportDisplayFieldAlias
methods.description: Renames the alias of a report display field.

methods.name: renameSelectedReportFilterFieldWhereCondition
methods.description: Renames the where condition string for a selected report filter field.

methods.name: updateReportDisplayFieldByFieldAlias
methods.description: Updates the class name for report display fields by field alias.

methods.name: updateScreenModuleId
methods.description: Updates the module ID and screen name for a specific screen based on its URL and module name.

methods.name: updateMenuItemIconNames
methods.description: Updates the icon name in the menu item's additional_params for a given menu title.
